title: Sources & Methodology — Cathedral Network
intro: The Cathedral Network aggregates open‑source intelligence, academic preprints, incident databases, and real‑time alert feeds. All data is publicly verifiable. Our methodology is transparent, and every prediction is logged with its outcome.

cards.title: 📊 Cathedral Proprietary Indices
paragraphs: GSCI (Global Systemic Collapse Index): weighted composite of 130+ threats, scaled 0–100. >75 indicates collapse imminent.
SSI (System Stress Index): tracks social and institutional strain (0–100).
SCP (Systemic Cascade Probability): Bayesian posterior probability of a cross‑domain cascade (0–100%).
SCA Tier: amplitude of active cascades (1–5). Tier 5 is 'Unprecedented'.
TBL (Threshold‑Based Logic): compares current values to historical baselines (30‑yr for climate, 10‑yr for energy, 5‑yr for conflict).
HEWD (Humanitarian Early Warning Dashboard): mortality_weight^0.7 × severity_factor × (1 + 0.2×recency).

cards.title: 📜 Prediction Log & Hit Rate
paragraphs: As of 10 June 2026: 77 confirmed, 4 falsified → 95.06% hit rate (resolved predictions).
All predictions are published with probabilities and outcome evidence. Falsified entries are retained in the public log (Law III).
Backtested against 7 historical collapses (Weimar, Argentina, Lebanon, Yugoslavia, Great Depression, Maya, GFC) – 96.8% retrospective accuracy.

oilIndexText: The Cathedral tracks both futures (paper) and physical crude prices. Our custom oil stress indicator combines Brent futures, Dated Brent, and war risk premiums. See the Oil Index page for live charts (planned).
communityText: Spotters submit ground observations via Signal and ProtonMail. All reports are end‑to‑end encrypted and anonymised. Wardens verify threats before publication. No personal data is ever collected.
analyticsText: We use GoatCounter (GDPR‑compliant, no cookies) to count unique visitors. No tracking, no profiling, no third‑party sharing.
